display_name: 旧 SIG_TIME 配方叠加 RDrop：E20/E50 三种子匹配验证
description: Original historical SIG_TIME RAW_HZ/normalaugmentation/LS.01/defaultcos with ORIGINAL oneCE,matched TWO_CE and RDROP(alpha1);18scratch E20/E50×3modes×3seeds. Actual postaugmentation IQ shared by the two stochastic L forwards. Source-only independent expansion per budget; rowwise automatic clean prediction/fresh CPU truth-last.
